nodes.label: Uzbek User Guide (Animated GIF)
nodes.description: 9-step animated guide in Uzbek language for generalmodern.uz. Step 1/9 visible: instructs user to open generalmodern.uz website and click the 'Kirish' (Login) button in the upper right corner. Shows a mockup of the public catalog page with 4 product cards and a highlighted Kirish button.

nodes.label: Step 1: Open generalmodern.uz Website
nodes.description: First step of the Uzbek guide. Heading: 'generalmodern.uz saytini oching' (Open the generalmodern.uz website). Instruction: 'Oʿng yuqoridagi «Kirish» tugmasini bosing' (Click the Login button in the upper right). The tab label is 'Sayt' (Website). Progress indicator shows 1/9.

nodes.label: Kirish (Login) Button
nodes.description: Dark-colored 'Kirish' button (Uzbek for 'Login' or 'Enter') located in the upper-right corner of the generalmodern.uz website. Highlighted with an animated cursor pointer indicator in the guide to draw user attention.

nodes.label: Public Product Catalog Screen
nodes.description: The generalmodern.uz public-facing catalog page shown in the guide mockup. Displays a 2x2 grid of product cards with placeholder images and text. URL bar shows 'generalmodern.uz'. This is the landing page before login.

nodes.label: User Login Flow (Uzbek Guide)
nodes.description: 9-step user flow covered by this animated Uzbek guide. Step 1 shows opening the site and clicking Kirish. Remaining 8 steps (not visible in this frame) likely cover: entering phone/password, receiving Telegram code, completing 2FA login, and accessing the customer portal.

nodes.label: GENERAL MODERN Brand Header
nodes.description: Guide header showing 'GENERAL MODERN' in gold/yellow uppercase text on dark navy background with a horizontal gold underline separator. Consistent with the warehouse system brand identity.
